_comment: Scoring constants. Source: data/site/rules.txt and data/site/faq.txt,
read live from fantasysurvivorgame.com/rules.html and /faq.html on 2026-09-17.
confidence: high = quoted verbatim from the site. low = not on the site; a guess.
The code reads every number here at run time. Nothing is hard-coded in fsb/.

vote.points_awarded: points assigned to the castaway who is voted out
vote.deadline: before the episode airs on the US East coast
counts_as_voted_out: most votes and sent somewhere else, e.g. Extinction Island
vote.double_boot_or_split_tribal: not addressed on the rules page. Each castaway voted out that night is presumably scored the same way, since the rule is per-castaway, not per-episode. Unconfirmed - question 5, still open.
vote.tribe_swap_budget: the rule reads '10 points per tribe, each week'. If a swap creates a third tribe, the budget scales to 10 x (tribe count) that week. This is a direct reading of the rule text, not a separate confirmation - question 6, still open.

outplay._source: each value below is the exact point award named on the rules page, one entry per named action

action_notes.read_tree_mail: limit once per episode per castaway
action_notes.water_well_strategize: limit once per episode per castaway
action_notes.make_fire_at_camp: limit once per episode per castaway
action_notes.find_food: limit once per episode per castaway
action_notes.go_on_journey: limit once per episode per castaway
action_notes.individual_reward_win: the winner AND any castaway they choose to bring also earn this

conflict: rules.html says: 'Once a castaway leaves the game... they will continue to
earn 1 point for each subsequent episode they are out of the game', 0-13 points.
faq.html says: 'What happens when my drafted survivor gets voted out? The
survivor will stop earning you points.' These two site pages disagree.
This file uses the rules.html number, because that page is titled the
official rules and is the more specific of the two. Not independently
confirmed. Verify against a real scored episode before trusting it.

outplay.roster_size_confidence: unknown - not stated on any page read so far. Needs the account draft page (behind login). Question 1, still open.
outplay.roster_editable_confidence: unknown - the FAQ says a league cannot be LEFT once drafting begins, which is a different question from whether the roster can be edited after the draft. Needs the account draft page. Question 2, still open.

into the final episode must be the actual winner. Points paid = 1 per
consecutive episode, counting backward from and including the final
